# Hunt the golden zombies with TWO squads at once, out of one run.
# ru: Бить золотых зомби ДВУМЯ отрядами сразу, одним прогоном.
#
# GENERATED by tools/lib/golden_twin.py — edit that, not this.
#
# Two runs cannot hunt at once: the link refuses a second run of the same profile
# before the claim registry is asked, and that is right — one client, one driver.
# So one run drives both squads, and the twin's separate state is what lets it:
# side A works on `__lw_gold`, side B on `__lw_gold2`.
#
# THE LAP IS NOT THE CHAIN'S LAP. The chain opens by waiting for its march to
# land, which is the idling this exists to remove. Here each side is asked whether
# its squad is free, and only a free one is judged, given a target and sent — so
# while one squad marches the other is choosing and being sent.

ARGS squad_a = 2
ARGS squad_b = 3
ARGS radius = 2000
ARGS reach = 600
ARGS reach_far = 700
ARGS breathers = 30
ARGS limit = 0
ARGS approach_sec = 60
ARGS approach_reach = 12
ARGS miss_limit = 6
ARGS refresh_after = 3
ARGS laps = 400

DETACH

WAIT client == ready WITHIN 180s

IF scene != world
    LOG "Putting the map up first — the monsters live in the world scene."
    GAME WORLD
    WAIT scene == world WITHIN 30s

CALL fill_empty_squads

LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_squad = {squad_a}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_radius = {radius}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_reach = {reach}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_reach_far = {reach_far}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_breathers = {breathers}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_limit = {limit}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_back = 0
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_approach_sec = {approach_sec}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_approach_reach = {approach_reach}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold_refresh_after = {refresh_after}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_squad = {squad_b}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_radius = {radius}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_reach = {reach}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_reach_far = {reach_far}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_breathers = {breathers}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_limit = {limit}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_back = 0
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_approach_sec = {approach_sec}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_approach_reach = {approach_reach}
LUA DataCenter.__lw_gold2_refresh_after = {refresh_after}

TAP golden_arm
TAP golden2_arm
READ_LUA (function() local p = DataCenter.__lw_gold or {} local _zc = DataCenter.__lw_zclaims if type(_zc) ~= 'table' then _zc = {} DataCenter.__lw_zclaims = _zc end local function _goldnow() local t = nil pcall(function() t = tonumber(UITimeManager.Instance:GetServerTime()) end) if t == nil then t = os.time() * 1000 end return t end local function _goldfree(p, pid) local c = _zc[tostring(pid)] if c == nil then return true end if tostring(c.sq) == tostring(p.squad) then return true end return (_goldnow() - (tonumber(c.at) or 0)) > (300 * 1000) end local function _goldclaim(p, pid) _zc[tostring(pid)] = {sq = p.squad, at = _goldnow()} end if p.formation == nil then return 0 end if (tonumber(p.soldiers) or 0) <= 0 then return -1 end return 1 end)() INTO armed_a
READ_LUA (function() local p = DataCenter.__lw_gold2 or {} local _zc = DataCenter.__lw_zclaims if type(_zc) ~= 'table' then _zc = {} DataCenter.__lw_zclaims = _zc end local function _goldnow() local t = nil pcall(function() t = tonumber(UITimeManager.Instance:GetServerTime()) end) if t == nil then t = os.time() * 1000 end return t end local function _goldfree(p, pid) local c = _zc[tostring(pid)] if c == nil then return true end if tostring(c.sq) == tostring(p.squad) then return true end return (_goldnow() - (tonumber(c.at) or 0)) > (300 * 1000) end local function _goldclaim(p, pid) _zc[tostring(pid)] = {sq = p.squad, at = _goldnow()} end if p.formation == nil then return 0 end if (tonumber(p.soldiers) or 0) <= 0 then return -1 end return 1 end)() INTO armed_b
IF armed_a < 1
    LOG "the first squad cannot hunt — it has no army or no such slot; going on with the other"
IF armed_b < 1
    LOG "the second squad cannot hunt — it has no army or no such slot; going on with the other"

# The ground around each side's origin, once, before either is sent anywhere.

WHILE refreshed == 0 LIMIT 20
    WAIT 1
    READ_LUA (function() local p = DataCenter.__lw_gold or {} local _zc = DataCenter.__lw_zclaims if type(_zc) ~= 'table' then _zc = {} DataCenter.__lw_zclaims = _zc end local function _goldnow() local t = nil pcall(function() t = tonumber(UITimeManager.Instance:GetServerTime()) end) if t == nil then t = os.time() * 1000 end return t end local function _goldfree(p, pid) local c = _zc[tostring(pid)] if c == nil then return true end if tostring(c.sq) == tostring(p.squad) then return true end return (_goldnow() - (tonumber(c.at) or 0)) > (300 * 1000) end local function _goldclaim(p, pid) _zc[tostring(pid)] = {sq = p.squad, at = _goldnow()} end return (math.floor(tonumber(p.refresh_done) or 0) == 1) and 1 or 0 end)() INTO refreshed
